prompt: One quiet close-miked Foley gesture lasting about one second. An empty chipped enamel soup bowl is gently pushed across the dusty packed-earth floor of an old wooden shed. A gritty low scrape travels a short distance, a few grains tick against thin metal, then a tiny hollow wobble as the bowl settles. Intimate and tentative, softly made by a tired hand. No spoon or water, no falling impact, no voice, no music or ambience.
